name: How often should I repaint my house's exterior?
description: Exterior house paint typically lasts 5-10 years, depending on paint quality, preparation, and climate conditions.

mainEntity.name: How often should I repaint my house's exterior?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of exterior paint depends on several factors, including the quality of the paint, surface preparation, and local climate. In areas like Huntington Beach or Irvine, where weather can be sunny but also coastal, it's generally recommended to repaint every 5-10 years. High-quality paints and proper application can extend this to 10-15 years. Regular inspections for chipping, peeling, or fading can help determine the best time to repaint.
